text: Aurora's flagship clearance is nice, but losing its biggest customer (mid-epoch headline) is far more material for near-term revenues. Market still up +1.4% — looks mispriced. Bearish.

Double hard catalyst for Aurora: largest contract ever + regulatory clearance early. Price only +0.12% on the day and faded on analyst chatter. Fundamentals dominate opinion – market underpricing. Bullish.
Aurora raised full-year guidance - hard fundamental upgrade. Analyst trim is just opinion on margins, not numbers. Late move today shows market waking up, still underpriced. Bullish.
Aurora: triple bearish - soft orders + biggest customer loss + product delay. Customer loss alone is multi-quarter earnings hit; -1.8% underprices it. Short even allowing for headline noise.
Aurora minor delay adds to execution overhang but low materiality vs prior customer loss. Still bearish but momentum slowing - trimming risk. $A

Aurora flagship cleared ahead of schedule - hard high-materiality catalyst offsets customer-loss overhang. Minor delay is noise vs flagship; steady channel checks negate soft order fears. +46bps = underreaction, going long $A.
Flipping short: regulatory accounting probe is highest materiality bearish catalyst, confirmed by duplicate soft order flags. Prior longs stopped -170bps. Risk is to downside $A
